warnings: Chloride follows salt: calculate it from the salt/sodium log (1 g salt = 607 mg chloride); do not ask users to eat more salt to reach it.
IFCT 2017 has no chloride values; plain-food chloride is Not found. Processed-food chloride is an estimate (sodium x 1.54, upper bound).
ICMR chloride values are secondary, unverified (OCR of FSSAI direction); ICMR EAR and TUL Not found.
good_source_dishes lists the lighter-salt dish picks, not chloride-rich dishes.
Potassium-chloride salt substitutes and KCl tablets are not for kidney disease, pregnancy or users of ACE inhibitors, ARBs or potassium-sparing diuretics unless a doctor agrees.
Users with kidney, heart or liver disease, pregnancy, or on diuretics: show only the general range plus 'Follow your doctor's advice'; never push higher or lower salt, chloride or water.
Repeated vomiting, severe diarrhoea, confusion or seizure: see a doctor now.
